about: Hand decisions about MLA3 stat blocks that scripts/msh/roster.py applies after parsing (scripts/msh/gridbooks.py reads this book). The two misprints were read off the page images at 250 dpi (survey apps/marvel-heroes/docs/surveys/mla3.md, the misprints tables of Stat blocks; decision 5), the printed Karma 0 and the second grids' labels are decisions 6 and 4; none is a guess from OCR.
Facts only - numbers, rank codes and a few words of a label - so this file is committed while roster.json stays in the local cache.
match     {page, header, codes}: the printed page in the Adventure Book, the start of the entry's header, and where one card holds two blocks the block's seven codes as read
verdict   misprint    the book prints a value its own arithmetic contradicts; 'printed' keeps what the page says, 'corrected' what the rules give
as_printed  the page is unambiguous and the check still fails; kept as printed, and the note says why
label       the name of a second block on a card (decision 4)

text        match {row}: an msh_book_text row key. 'read' is a fragment of a few words as the OCR gives it after folding to ASCII, 'printed' the same fragment as the page prints it. It must occur once in the row, or npcs.py stops.
also      further values of the same block, each {verdict, field, printed, and corrected for a misprint}: one override matches one block, and a block can print more than one thing to explain
checked   the date the page image was read
The book's other Feeble and Shift 0 spellings (FE, SH-0, Sh-0) have no override: the numbers are right, and they are rank_aliases and the registry's Shift 0 fields (decision 5).

overrides.note: Printed Health 70 (printed 53): F and A EX 20, S and E RM 30, each code agreeing with its number (read at 250 dpi), sum to 100, and the Karma 18 holds; MLA2's Guardsmen print the same misprint. Survey decision 5.

Printed Health 200 (printed 60): F UN 100, A EX 20, S and E MN 75, each code agreeing with its number, sum to 270, and the Karma 50 holds; MLA2's Thor prints the same misprint. The codes match his own block, not Eric Masterson's on the same card. Survey decision 5.
